Use an opportunity in three steps

  1. Open the original website. Check the date, eligibility, cost and participation rules.
  2. Decide whether it fits your goal. A listed organization or program is a starting point, not a promise of acceptance, leads or business.
  3. Choose what to do next. Contact or participate only when you decide the current details and fit make sense.
